name: interview-practice
description: Practice interviews with an adaptive AI interviewer: voice or text answers, follow-up probes, STAR and filler-word analytics, and a scored report.

paragraphs: Practice interviews with an adaptive AI interviewer: voice or text answers, follow-up probes, STAR and filler-word analytics, and a scored report.

Pick a role, level, interview type (behavioral, technical concepts, system design, product sense) and an interviewer persona, from a friendly recruiter to a tough senior engineer. The AI asks one question at a time, can read it aloud, and after each answer decides whether a follow-up probe would expose more depth: a vague claim, a missing result, or 'we' where it should be 'I'. You can answer by typing or by speaking (Web Speech API). Live local analytics track length, pace (wpm), filler words, hedges, concrete numbers, I-vs-we ownership and STAR structure as you talk. features: Configurable role, level, interview type, persona, question count
Adaptive follow-up probes decided by the AI from your actual answer
Voice answers via SpeechRecognition with live transcription; questions via speech synthesis
Live analytics: words, wpm, fillers, hedges, numbers, I/we ownership, STAR detector
Scored report: per-answer 1-5, strengths, fixes, stronger-answer outlines, overall signal
